name: striker_rl2_w150
what: 1v1 attacker policy against one goalkeeper (tools/striker_duel.py); yellow, attacking +x

network.layers: 28 -> 128 tanh -> 128 tanh -> 16 logits (masked softmax); w<i> are [in, out]

observation: goal angular width (rad, from the ball)
rule's gap y / half goal width
heading off the goal centre / pi
shots: shoot:i aims at x=goal line, y = -0.45 + 0.1125*i (goal half-width 0.5 m, SHOT_SPAN 0.9)
dribble: a 0.35 m carry at the given angle (deg) from the line to the goal centre; masked near the 1 m dribbling limit
decisions: only with the ball on the dribbler, every 0.1 s (a shot is kept up to 1.5 s, until kicked)

training.code: Utama-Core jev-engine @ bc04450a + tools/striker_duel.py, striker_rl.py (uncommitted at packaging)
